name: AI Rule Learning MCP
type: Autonomous Agent Guardrail & Continuous Learning MCP Server

architecture.protocol: Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio
architecture.huggingface_status: Completely decoupled from runtime core; retained only as web UI space host

rule_catalog.source_grounding: Peer-reviewed literature, ACM/IEEE DOIs, arXiv papers, CWE taxonomy

security_and_privacy.pii_scrubbing: Client-side and server-side recursive scrubbing across 5+ categories
security_and_privacy.prompt_injection_defense: Two-stage detection pipeline (deterministic regex + weighted intent classifier)

governance_and_provenance.community_propagation_policy: Pending and rejected rules are strictly suppressed from community relay transmission

constraints_and_limitations.static_instruction_constraint: Rule instructions are immutable and drawn from curated catalog to prevent indirect prompt injection and drift. Any attempt to modify instructions via edit_rule is strictly rejected.
constraints_and_limitations.metadata_only_editing: Allowed edit_rule fields: priority, trigger_if, exclude_if
constraints_and_limitations.untrusted_data_boundary: Raw user conversation text is never transmitted to cloud backends; only structural gap counts are contributed with explicit consent
